3.2.0: Streaks! Log at least one entry a day to grow your streak and unlock 5 streak buddies.
Streak freezes: every 7 days in a row earns one, and it saves your streak if you miss a day.
Miss a day with no freeze? Your streak goes grey — log 3 days in a row to relight it.
Notes remember what you typed before — tap the note box to pick a past one.
"Add to a goal" now saves its note.
New Home layout, and the app now asks before installing updates.
